text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer. I know there are chilled delivery services that keep stuff cold, but are there delivery services that keep things hot too?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Akebono steps into my office and immediately throws me for a loop with her bizarre question.
choice_data_list: I don't think those exist… Why do you ask?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ehehe… So actually, I got this letter in the mail…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: And it said, "I love watching you race, Miss Bono! You're big and powerful like a truck!" ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Reading that made me so happy! I was going to write back, but the sender's mom added a note saying not to worry about replying, since I'm probably so busy.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: So instead of a letter, I thought I could send them a pot of Nankai chanko! ♪
choice_data_list: I don't think that's a good idea…
I don't think that's a good idea…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh, really? Well, I guess I can't anyway if there aren't any heated delivery services around.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Wait, I know! I can just use a chilled delivery service to send them a tub of homemade ice cream!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I'd better start making it now! ♪ I'm just going to head out to the neighborhood supermarket real qui—
choice_data_list: Wait, just send them a normal letter!
Wait, just send them a normal letter!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I hastily stop Hishi Akebono before she runs off. She might have a big appetite, but it looks like that fan letter has filled her right up with happiness.
